$comment: SPDX identifier to canonical license URL. The ONE table: src/utils/license.ts, src/utils/projects.ts, src/content.config.ts (which refuses a project license with an identifier missing here), scripts/ci/build-projects.mjs and scripts/ci/check-software-drift.mjs all read it, so a Node script that cannot import a .ts does not need its own copy. Same arrangement as knows-about-wikidata.json. A LicenseRef- entry names terms that are not on the SPDX list, so its URL is the license file of the one project that declares it (LicenseRef-EASA-ANP: the EASA ANP tables phonometry bundles, as its PyPI license_expression names them).
